title: OnCache: Learning Dynamic Caching Schedules for Efficient Diffusion Inference
abstract: arXiv:2611.29480v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion models have revolutionized generative tasks but incur high inference latency due to iterative denoising. Cache-based strategies accelerate inference by reusing intermediate features, yet they largely rely on static, sample-agnostic schedules. Our empirical analysis reveals two factors that these schedules overlook. (i) denoising dynamics and computational requirements vary across prompts, motivating adaptive computation allocation. (ii) sensitivity to caching errors varies across timesteps, so static schedules may reuse features at error-sensitive steps or waste computation at less sensitive ones. We therefore propose OnCache, a dynamic caching framework that makes prompt-adaptive decisions online about how much computation to allocate and when to refresh cached features. A policy is trained offline on paired compute and cache continuations from identical denoising states, using differences in terminal fidelity and the number

translated_title: OnCache：学习动态缓存调度以实现高效扩散模型推理
translated_abstract: 扩散模型在生成任务中取得了革命性进展，但由于迭代去噪过程而带来较高的推理延迟。基于缓存的策略通过重用中间特征来加速推理，然而它们在很大程度上依赖于静态的、与样本无关的调度方案。我们的实证分析揭示了这些调度方案所忽视的两个因素：（i）去噪动态和计算需求因提示词不同而变化，这促使需要自适应的计算资源分配；（ii）对缓存错误的敏感性随时间步而变化，因此静态调度可能在错误敏感的步骤重用特征，或在敏感度较低的步骤浪费计算资源。因此，我们提出了OnCache，这是一个动态缓存框架，能够在线做出针对提示词自适应的决策，即分配多少计算资源以及何时刷新缓存特征。该策略在来自相同去噪状态的配对计算与缓存延续上离线训练，利用最终保真度的差异和计算量……
tldr: OnCache提出了一种动态缓存框架，可根据不同提示词在线自适应地分配计算资源并决定何时刷新缓存特征，从而实现更高效的扩散模型推理。
en_tdlr: OnCache proposes a dynamic caching framework that adaptively allocates computation and decides when to refresh cached features online on a per-prompt basis, enabling more efficient diffusion model inference.
